understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each level’s grid to reach and complete all goal cells. A goal cell only completes when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required attributes; completing all goals advances to the next level, and finishing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (north/south/east/west) costs 1 stamina; when stamina hits 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to max, and losing all lives ends the game. Walls block movement, and the state provides a blocked_directions list that must never be chosen. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape tiles cycle shape IDs 0–5 (wrapping), color tiles cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation tiles rotate 90° clockwise through 0°→90°→180°→270°→0°. A goal activates only when shape+color+rotation all match simultaneously, and stepping onto an activated goal completes it; stamina refill tiles restore stamina.
